text:
Anya (Growth): Heads up — finalizing the launch newsletter for the Spring product debut next Tue. Draft is in the doc. Need quick decisions on segmenting, subject A/B, and webinar CTA timing.
Sam Park: Sending draft now — link: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-newsletter-draft (comments welcome).
Lidia Wong: Quick read — looks good. Question: are we splitting by product usage (API callers vs console users) or by ARR/lead score?
Anya (Growth): Prioritize usage-based split for the initial blast (API vs Console), then a 2nd wave segmented by lead score for sales follow-up. Rationale: usage signal converts faster.
Ravi (Content): Proposed subject lines: A) "Meet Redwood Inference — predictable LLM inference for production" B) "How to cut inference costs and keep latency tight" — prefer A for product intro, B for money-focused segment.
Sam Park: Agree. My plan: 50/50 A/B across the whole audience, then per-segment winners get rolled into the follow-up.
Lidia Wong: Timing: send Tue 10am PT for North America, Wed 10am CET for EMEA. Webinar CTA should go to the 2pm PT webinar (for NA) and a follow-up replay link for EMEA time zone.
Anya (Growth): @Ravi can you craft two CTA variants for the email body? One CTA is "Reserve your spot" (webinar-first), the other is "Read benchmark summary" (benchmarks-first). We'll multi-arm test which drives more sign-ups vs reads.
Ravi (Content): On it. Draft CTAs in thread by EOD. Also adding a short testimonial snippet from Beta customer X (one line) to boost credibility.
Sam Park: Segmentation rules (to confirm):
- Segment A: Active API callers in last 30 days (exclude those already on Dedicated)
- Segment B: Console trialers who haven't completed deploy
- Segment C: High-score leads (>= 70) in CRM for SDR handoff
- Suppress: unsubscribed, bounced in last 90d, and anyone who saw the private beta email earlier.
Lidia Wong: For the follow-up drip: 3-touch cadence over 10 days. Touch 1 = webinar invite, Touch 2 = benchmark highlights + CTA, Touch 3 = case study + SDR reachout for high-score leads.
Anya (Growth): Tracking: UTM params: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=spring_debut_v1&utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Make sure GA events fire on click and the webinar reg page captures original utm.
Sam Park: I'll create the send lists and export CSVs. @OpsBot please run the suppression check and return counts.
OpsBot: Suppression check started. Estimated send counts:
- Segment A: 12,432
- Segment B: 4,210
- Segment C: 812
- Total after suppression: 15,054
OpsBot: Suppression check complete — 3.7% invalid emails, 0.9% recent bounces filtered.
Ravi (Content): Drafted two hero paragraphs and CTA variants. Pasting quick copy here:
"Variant CTA 1 — Reserve your spot: Join our product team and early customers to see how we shave latency and cost off LLM features. Seats limited."
"Variant CTA 2 — Read the benchmark: Get a concise one-pager showing latency and cost vs common baseline models."
Sam Park: For A/B tracking: set header x-email-variant and add campaign tag in ESP. Also schedule a 24h winner evaluation window and auto-send winner to remaining recipients.
Lidia Wong: Can we include a small inline survey for webinar intent (Yes / Maybe) — it boosts quality of registrants.
Anya (Growth): Yes, include a one-click intent button. Also, for enterprise segment, add a second follow-up email with an SDR intro template 48h after the webinar if they opened or clicked.
Ravi (Content): I'll add a short preheader too: "See the benchmark that changed our infra choices".
Sam Park: Final checklist for send: 1) List exports 2) Suppression pass 3) Creative/CTAs in ESP 4) Subject lines A/B loaded 5) UTMs + tracking 6) Webinar reg page health check. I can run 1-3 tomorrow morning.
Anya (Growth): Great. Owners: Sam (lists + scheduling), Ravi (copy + CTAs), Lidia (timing + follow-up cadence). Aim to lock by Mon 5pm PT.
Lidia Wong: Noted. Small ask: add a short sentence in the email for privacy/compliance (we use customer data for segmentation). I'll drop the exact line into the doc.
Anya (Growth): Thanks — if no blockers, greenlight to schedule A/B test. :rocket:
Sam Park: thumbs up. Scheduling for Tue 10am PT (NA) and Wed 10am CET (EMEA).
Ravi (Content): I'll push final copy and a trimmed HTML preview into the doc by EOD.
OpsBot: Reminder: deliverability window set for 10:00 PT send. Monitoring alerts will be posted to #deliverability during send.
Anya (Growth): Perfect — we'll meet Mon 3pm for a final readout.
Sam Park: see you then.
Lidia Wong: thanks team! :heart:
